name: getFlagShow
description: Returns whether the Digitized Sky Survey (DSS) background textures are currently displayed. When enabled, Stellarium shows real photographic survey images behind the stars and deep-sky objects.
returnDescription: true if DSS textures are visible, false if hidden

compatibility.notes: Introduced in early Stellarium versions; stable since 0.10.0

name: setFlagShow
description: Enables or disables the Digitized Sky Survey (DSS) background. When enabled, real photographic textures (TOAST format) are displayed behind the stars and deep-sky objects, providing a realistic view of the sky.

parameters.name: displayed
parameters.description: true to show DSS background, false to hide it

compatibility.notes: Introduced in early Stellarium versions; stable since 0.10
